programme.title: Fantastic Planet
programme.desc: This animated tale follows the relationship between the small human-like Oms and their much larger blue-skinned oppressors, the Draags, who rule the planet of Ygam. While the Draags have long kept Oms as illiterate pets, this hierarchy shifts after an Om boy becomes educated, thanks to a young female Draag. This leads to an Om rebellion, which weakens the Draag control over their race. Will the Oms and the Draags find a way to coexist? Or will they destroy each other?

But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island.

programme.desc: Directed by Al Reinert and with music scored by Brian Eno, "For All Mankind" provides a testament to NASA's Apollo program of the 1960s and '70s. Composed of actual NASA footage of the missions and astronaut interviews, the documentary offers the viewpoint of the individuals who braved the remarkable journey to the moon and back. While compiling the material for the film, Reinert went through more than six million feet of film of these historic moments.

programme.title: Doble riesgo
programme.desc: Judd interpreta a Libby Parsons, condenada por asesinar a su esposo. Descubre que él falsificó su propia "muerte" y la incriminó. En libertad condicional, se propone a buscarlo, y le deja pistas a su agente Travis Lehman (Jones).

programme.title: Bajo fuego
programme.desc: El Coronel Terry Childers es un patriota y un héroe de guerra. Pero cuando una misión de paz en Yemen liderada por él resulta mal, termina enfrentando una corte marcial.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: Esteban y Aylin comienzan un romance. La llegada del nuevo EX sorprende a todos y la Tablet los manda a una cita de tres. La Sala Tornado pone las cartas sobre la mesa. Brandon toma una decisión importante.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: La tensión parece calmarse tras la reconciliación entre Diana y Brandon. Camilo y David tienen una plática sincera y Kelly aclara sus intenciones con Karen. Daphne saca su furia y arremte contra Aylin.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: Dos nuevos EX llegan a la Villa y se desatan los celos. Diana deja las cosas claras con Brandon en la Love Suite. Todos disfrutan de un día fuera de la Villa y el alcohol les ayuda a encararse.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: Esteban busca hacer un trío y Aylin busca exclusividad. Llega un nuevo EX y hace que Frida respire de nuevo. Diana esta insegura de Brandon. Kelly es mas territorial con Robbie por culpa de Michelle.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: En medio de una fiesta, Camilo se casa con David en el peor momento y se abre la Sala Tornado desatando nuevos conflictos. Kim va por Ian, mientras que Suavecito llama a no engancharse con sus parejas.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: Karen y Suavecito se van a una cita y se desatan los celos incontrolables de Kim y se despide de Ian. La peluca María José trae revelaciones importantes y llega un nuevo EX a saldar cuentas.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: Frida y Brandon se reencuentran y Diana toma cartas en el asunto. Kim y Suavecito se besan apasionadamente pero Ian tiene un As bajo la manga. La llegada de un nuevo Ex y alguien es expulsado.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: La Sala Tornado llama a votaciones. Algunos se van de fiesta a una casa flotante. La salida de Daphne se convierte en el pretexto para hacer explotar una bomba de tiempo que provoca una gran pelea.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: Una dinámica los obliga a decirse las cosas de frente. Michelle y Kelly arreglan sus diferencias en la Sala Tornado. Salen por grupos a disfrutar de Colombia. Festejan el cumpleaños de Diana.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP
programme.desc: Las vacaciones llegaron a su fin y las relaciones comienzan un nuevo ciclo en un barco a Cartagena. David y Camilo aclaran los malentendidos. Hacen un último brindis todos juntos.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: ¡Celos, arena y mar!
programme.desc: Los influencers más top llegan a Cartagena. Leslie e Isaac se encuentran por primera vez después de conocerse por las redes sociales. Una riña entre Lizbeth y Ana comienza a dividir a los bandos en la villa. El primer ex hace temblar a algunos.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: La manada más salvaje
programme.desc: Lizbeth y Diana se perfilan como las más odiadas del grupo, mientras que el nuevo ex le quita el lugar a Christian. Yurgenis avanza con Brandon y una fiesta salvaje rompe con todo lo que ellos creían de sí mismos.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: De la broma a la guerra
programme.desc: La tablet manda a Ana e Isaac a una cita romántica y Leslie tambalea. La sala tornado abre sus puertas y sus vientos traen muchas dudas. Lizbeth y Diana planean una broma que no termina nada bien. La llegada del próximo ex podría ser devastadora.
programme.sub-title: De la broma a la guerra

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: El tiburón tiene colmillo
programme.desc: Los nuevos ex abren las puertas a más problemas. Diana se pone malacopa y amarga la fiesta más dulce. Un tiburón de dos patas visita la villa y lo que parecía un chiste termina siendo una verdadera amenaza. La primera Love Suite es para...

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: Shots con sentimiento
programme.desc: La llegada de Michelle hace arder la villa. La sala tornado pone de cabeza los sentimientos de Leslie. Christian inicia la llama del amor con Andrea mientras que Diana provoca una explosión.

programme.title: La Venganza de los Ex VIP: No soportas, ¿verdad?
programme.desc: Lalo viene a terminar los pendientes con Leslie y a Isaac le toca atacarse. Lizbeth explota contra Isaac y Rufas. Yurgenis se libera en un catamarán, sin la sombra de Brandon. El nuevo ex llega muy salsa, pero de la que no pica.

programme.title: Elefante blanco
programme.desc: Un asesino es contratado por un hombre de negocios para vengar el asesinato de su hija por parte de traficantes de esclavos blancos en Tailandia.

programme.title: Colateral: Lugar y tiempo equivocado
programme.desc: Vincent es un asesino a sueldo tranquilo y calculador que está en su mejor momento. Max es un taxista con grandes sueños y sin resultados. Esta noche, Max llevará a Vincent a su próximo trabajo. Una noche, cinco paradas, cinco asesinatos y un escape.

programme.title: Bent: Plan de venganza
programme.desc: En este mordaz thriller policíaco, un policía desacreditado que busca al asesino de su compañero descubre accidentalmente una conspiración gubernamental vinculada al asesinato de una mujer con un coche bomba.

programme.title: Misión imposible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise), un agente secreto, es incriminado por la muerte de su compañero de espionaje e intenta deshacerse de los asesinos del gobierno que lo persiguen. Corre contra el reloj mientras intenta descubrir la verdad.

programme.title: Misión imposible 2
programme.desc: El espía más grande del mundo, Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise), regresa junto con la hermosa Nyah Hall para detener al agente renegado Sean Ambrose, antes de que este libere un nuevo tipo de terror en un mundo desprevenido.

programme.title: Misión: Imposible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt se enfrenta cara a cara con un traficante de armas peligroso y sádico al tratar de mantener su identidad en secreto para proteger a su novia.

programme.title: Misión imposible 4: Protocolo fantasma
programme.desc: El FMI se cierra cuando participa en el bombardeo del Kremlin, lo que provoca que Ethan Hunt y su nuevo equipo se conviertan en rebeldes para limpiar el nombre de su organización.

programme.title: Misión imposible 5: Nación secreta
programme.desc: Ethan y su equipo se embarcan en su misión más imposible hasta ahora, erradicando el Sindicato, una organización internacional ilegal tan altamente capacitada como ellos, comprometida con la destrucción del FMI.

programme.title: Mega Piranha (LAS)
programme.desc: Una cepa mutante de pirañas feroces gigantes escapan del Amazonas y se dirigen a Florida.

programme.title: El mega tiburón contra el pulpo gigante
programme.desc: Incidentes inexplicables están ocurriendo en todo el océano Pacífico cuando un grupo de científicos rebeldes descubre a un megalodón prehistórico y desata a un pulpo gigante como resultado de una operación militar ilegal.

programme.title: La casa de los mil cuerpos
programme.desc: Dos parejas de adolescentes que viajan por los bosques de Texas en busca de leyendas urbanas de asesinos en serie terminan siendo prisioneros de una extraña y sádica familia de asesinos seriales.

programme.title: Nurse 3D
programme.desc: Cuando una amistad se convierte en obsesión, una enfermera desata una ola de terror.

programme.title: Viernes 13, parte V: un nuevo comienzo
programme.desc: Esta vez parece haber puesto la mira en los pacientes jóvenes de una casa aislada. Y más de unos pocos de sus objetivos adolescentes terminan por la mitad, en cuartos ... lo que sea, Jason lo hace.

programme.title: Viernes 13 parte VI: Jason vive
programme.desc: De niño, Tommy Jarvis hizo algo que muchos murieron intentando hacer: mató a Jason Vorhees, el asesino que aterrorizó a Crystal Lake. Ahora, años después, Tommy está atormentado por el temor de que Jason siga vivo.

programme.title: Viernes 13, parte VII: la nueva sangre
programme.desc: Desde que el maníaco homicida Jason Voorhees quedó atrapado en cadenas en el fondo de Crystal Lake, el campamento de verano cercano ha funcionado sin problemas ... sin asesinato.

programme.title: Viernes 13, parte VIII: Jason invade Manhattan
programme.desc: La Gran Manzana está en grandes problemas, ya que el indestructible psicópata Jason Voorhees sale a la ciudad de Nueva York y pinta la ciudad de "rojo".

programme.title: Viernes 13, parte V: un nuevo comienzo

programme.title: Avenida Cloverfield 10
programme.desc: Después de un accidente de autos, una mujer despierta en el búnker de un supervivencialista. Él afirma haberla salvado de un ataque apocalíptico, pero al sospechar de sus intenciones, ella deberá escapar para descubrir la verdad.

programme.title: Asilo Embrujado
programme.desc: Cuando un grupo de exploradores urbanos tiene la oportunidad de explorar uno de los manicomios más embrujados del mundo, encuentra algo verdaderamente maligno que no los dejará salir y los llevará al límite de la cordura.

programme.title: Operación Overlord
programme.desc: Nada puede prepararte para el caos alucinante de Operación Overlord. El mega productor J.J. Abrams crea un emocionante viaje retorcido sobre un equipo de tropas estadounidenses que se encuentran cara a cara con los súper soldados nazis nunca vistos.

programme.title: Cementerio Maldito
programme.desc: Basada en la aterradora novela de Stephen King. Después de que la familia Creed se muda a la zona rural de Maine, se topan con un antiguo cementerio con poderes siniestros.

programme.title: Cloverfield: Monstruo
programme.desc: Cinco neoyorquinos viven una lucha de vida o muerte para poder escapar de la ciudad cuando aparece un monstruo del tamaño de un rascacielos.

programme.title: Plantación Maldita
programme.desc: Cinco amigos de viaje de fin de semana se verán perdidos en medio de campos de granjas cuando unos cuervos ataquen su vehículo. Pronto se darán cuenta hay espantapájaros que se reproducen matando y forzando a sus víctimas a unirse a ellos.

programme.title: Fugitivo
programme.desc: Mientras está en un hospital mental una de las estudiantes de psicología Abby, tiene un encuentro escalofriante con un paciente de alto riesgo, Harmon. Más tarde, Harmon escapa del hospital dejando un rastro de muerte, y en busca de Abby

programme.title: El Aro

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024

programme.desc: The Robertson family pulls together a family reunion to give Mia a big send-off before her surgery.

programme.desc: When Willie agrees to sponsor Mountain Man's radio contest, a "Hands on a Hardbody" competition, he somehow finds himself competing against Si for Mountain Man's last minute prize: a woodchipper.

programme.desc: When the Robertsons participate in the West Monroe Fire Department pancake breakfast, the firemen invite Willie and his brothers to train with the department for the day. Meanwhile, Phil and Si accompany Miss Kay on a trip to visit a family grave.

programme.desc: When Willie contemplates re-branding the Duck Commander image, Jase takes issue with having an outsider design their image, so he and the guys create their own new logo and business cards. Meanwhile, Willie and Phil help Bella with her science project.

programme.desc: The guys realize it is time for the annual cleaning of the duck blinds when they come across a gator using one as a home. Meanwhile, while the kids are running the church car wash, Si and Willie disagree on the best way to draw in customers.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Men vs. Wild
programme.desc: Brotherly competition is taken to a whole new level when Jase and Willie challenge Alan and Jep to a survival race through the woods on Phil's property. Meanwhile, Si is interested in finding a new hobby when he sees Kay cutting coupons.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Return of the Beavers
programme.desc: When Phil discovers more beaver activity on the Robertson land, he recruits Jase, Jep, and Si to get rid of them. Meanwhile, Willie and Korie bring Bella to her first day of karate practice.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Duck Dynasty
programme.desc: Stumped on a way to celebrate Willie's birthday, Korie enlists the guys' help and Jase takes the reigns in planning a trip to the lake where Phil and Kay used to live. Meanwhile, the women realize a raccoon is inside the lake house.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Glory Is the Reward of Mallard
programme.desc: When Willie takes a business trip to Scotland to expand his duck call business, he brings the entire family along so they can reconnect with their Scottish roots. Willie organizes a bus tour to trace his family heritage.
programme.sub-title: Glory Is the Reward of Mallard

programme.desc: A special holiday episode of Duck Dynasty shows when the Robertson family took over the Thanksgiving special of a local TV show "Good Morning Arklamiss." Each family member presents a special holiday segment, with Willie and Jase serving as anchormen.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Quack in the Saddle
programme.desc: When Willie becomes the temporary owner of a thoroughbred, he and the guys take it to a local track and enter it into a race. Meanwhile, when Kay decides she wants to buy a new birdbath for her yard, she recruits Phil, Martin and Godwin.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: A Home for the Holidays
programme.desc: The Robertsons help a long time employee whose Mom has fallen on hard times by buying her a brand new house for Christmas. Jep, Jase, Martin and Godwin race to finish a deck in time for the big reveal, only to get sidetracked by a hammering competition.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: The Cannonball Runs
programme.desc: Jase enters an outhouse race to help promote Willie's Duck Diner, but when the Robertsons show up for the race, they face an unexpected rival - Phillip McMillan. Meanwhile, Willie attempts to create the world's greatest bologna sandwich.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Coop! There It Is!

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Friday Afternoon Lights
programme.desc: When Willie becomes an assistant coach on Lil' Will's struggling football team, his authority is tested when the kids challenge the adults to a scrimmage. Meanwhile, Kay brings Jep and Si to an aquarobics class at a local health club.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Master and Duck Commander

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Inlawful Entry
programme.desc: When Missy's parents visit, her father convinces Jase to take him on a quail hunt. But while their "bonding hunt" yields very few quail, it does bring them closer together as friends. Meanwhile, Willie helps John Luke start his own snow cone business.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Flock and Key
programme.desc: Si recruits his nephews to help him transport a storage container to his backyard, but things take a turn when Jep becomes locked inside the box. Meanwhile, Jase helps Mia prepare for her cheerleading competition, but the only problem is he has no idea.

programme.desc: When Willie's old rival Phillip McMillan challenges him to a game of dodgeball, Willie recruits his family members to settle a score once and for all. Meanwhile, Si thinks his cat is cheating on him with another family, so he recruits Miss Kay.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Drone Survivor
programme.desc: When Jase and Phil make a bet about whether or not human beings in a duck blind are visible from the air, Jep buys a drone copter to get a "bird's eye" view, but ends up losing it in the process.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Alan in Charge
programme.desc: Jase and the guys convince Willie to hire his older brother Alan to work at Duck Commander, but when Alan begins micromanaging everyone, they quickly change their mind. Meanwhile, the ladies take a self-defense class and use John Luke as a punching bag.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Renaissance Men
programme.desc: When the Robertsons throw a Renaissance Fair birthday party for Godwin, various family members compete in a tournament to win knighthood.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Heroes Welcome
programme.desc: In this special episode, the Duck Commander team surprises two wounded veterans with a trip to Monroe so they can be in an episode of Duck Dynasty. To show their support, the Robertson family stages a color run to bring awareness to our wounded soldiers.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Pie Hard
programme.desc: Willie and Alan agree to help Miss Kay open her own bakery, but things take a turn when Kay is asked to hand over her secret recipes. Meanwhile, the guys in the duck call room take an extended lunch break by driving to Mississippi.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Van He'llsing
programme.desc: When Missy and Jase's son Reed purchases an old van to boost his music career, his parents begin to question some of his choices. Meanwhile, Willie helps Jep prepare River for a competitive wrestling league by introducing him to his friend.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Toad to Perdition
programme.desc: When Willie and his brothers spend too much time frog hunting, their wives challenge them to a "frogging" competition.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: RV There Yet?
programme.desc: The Robertson family takes a road trip to Liberty University where they will drop off John Luke and Mary Kate for their first year of college. Along the way, they stop in Nashville to visit Willie's friend Colt Ford.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Willie & Korie's Anniversorry
programme.desc: The Robertson family throws a party for Willie & Korie's 25th anniversary, but things take a dramatic turn when Willie and Korie reveal a big secret. Meanwhile, when Jase blames Uncle Si for getting him a parking ticket.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Statue of Imitations
programme.desc: When Willie asks a local chainsaw artist to make him a statue, he gets a big surprise when it's revealed that the statue is of an unlikely subject - Willie himself. Meanwhile, Jep and Jessica attempt to help Kay with her hoarding.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: A Decent Proposal
programme.desc: On a trip to New York, Jase's son Reed proposes to his girlfriend, which inspires his father to fan the flames of romance back home with Missy. Meanwhile, Sadie asks Willie to be a guest lecturer at her business class.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Father Knows Pest
programme.desc: The tables are turned when the HOA comes to Jase for help to rid the neighborhood of a menacing beaver. Little Will has just gotten his learner's permit, and Willie and Si argue over which of them is the better driving instructor.

programme.title: Duck Dynasty: Wild Wild West Monroe
programme.desc: When Jase and Jep get into an argument over which of them is the rightful heir to their grandfather's old rifle, they decide to settle the argument with a marksmanship contest. Meanwhile, Willie and Korie help Rebecca prepare for her trip to Taiwan.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy puts up a valiant fight in order to keep his word to Sanji! But will he be able to last until Sanji arrives at the rendezvous? Meanwhile, Jimbei shares the awful truth about the wedding with the other Straw Hats.
programme.sub-title: The Rendezvous! Luffy, a One-on-One at His Limit!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji and Luffy meet finally - and while he is happy to feed Luffy to replenish his energy, Sanji's explanation of what actions he must take baffles Luffy! The crucial decision, to turn his back on his friends or his family, tears Sanji apart!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The newly reunited Luffy and Sanji hear from the rest of the Straw Hats in the mirror dimension! Then, Jimbei starts telling them about Capone "Gang" Bege and proposes a shocking plan to take down Big Mom!
programme.sub-title: Sanji Comes Back! Crash! The Tea Party from Hell!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats put Jimbei's plan into action and approach Bege with the possibility of an alliance. But before they are granted an audience, they must make themselves presentable!
programme.sub-title: A Secret Meeting! Luffy vs. the Fire Tank Pirates!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The proposed alliance between the Straw Hats and Bege unfolds! A gaseous blast from the past, Gastino, a member of Bege's team, reveals the secret weapon that the team plans to use against the Emperor!
programme.sub-title: The Deadly Pact! Luffy & Bege's Allied Forces!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Now, the assassination plan of Big Mom is all set and everyone starts preparing for the Tea Party. Montd'Or finds one of his crewmates, Bobbin the Disposer, dead, and suspects Sanji and Luffy of the crime.
programme.sub-title: Luffy Engages in a Secret Maneuver! The Wedding Full of Conspiracies Starts Soon!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The day has arrived! Guests from the criminal underground pour in droves, but some have their own agendas to settle! Big Mom's sons, however, stand in their way and show them what they've got! Meanwhile, Luffy is preparing for his own plan!
programme.sub-title: The Family Gets Together! The Hellish Tea Party Starts!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Final preparations abound on all sides and multiple plots start to come together! But can Sanji keep his nerve and go through with the plan? Or will Pudding's beauty prove too enchanting?
programme.sub-title: The Broken Couple! Sanji and Pudding Enter!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: All plans go into action as the moment of the wedding arrives - but as the veil is lifted on Pudding's grotesque face, all hell breaks loose and unexpected circumstances mean chaos at the altar! Meanwhile, Luffy charges in, adding to the mayhem!
programme.sub-title: A Deadly Kiss! The Mission to Assassinate the Emperor Kicks Off!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The plan is launched! Big Mom falls to pieces as the wedding - and the wedding cake - are destroyed and a slew of Luffys are wreaking havoc around the site. But just when Luffy gets in trouble, Jimbei confronts Big Mom bravely!
programme.sub-title: Returning the Sake Cup! The Manly Jimbei Pays His Debt!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The plan is in full swing however - Big Mom is pushed past the edge of sanity and can't even bring herself to act. Meanwhile, her children make a move against Germa and Pudding takes up her original aim of killing Sanji!
programme.sub-title: The Mission Failed?! The Big Mom Pirates Strike Back!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The plot is in full swing as Luffy dashes towards Big Mom to show her the broken portrait again! Sanji makes an effort to free his family and wins the respect of his sister, and Big Mom loses her wits!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The tragic and sad history of Big Mom is revealed! From abandonment, rescue, and again to ruin, Big Mom's voracious hunger has brought her into conflict with others from the very beginning!
programme.sub-title: Mom's Secret! The Giant's Island Elbaph and a Little Monster!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Linlin enrages the Giants as she slays their respected warrior - but Mother throws herself on their mercy and begs for clemency for her beloved Linlin, forcing the troupe to leave Elbaph for good.
programme.sub-title: The Birth of Mom! The Day That Carmel Vanished!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Linlin, destroyed at the disappearance of Mother, falls in with a new cohort and finds a reason to go on living, proving herself a mighty force to be reckoned with! The Straw Hats' plan goes awry, and all hope looks to be lost!
programme.sub-title: The Launcher Blasts! The Moment of Big Mom's Assassination!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Bege and the Straw Hats are on the defensive as the full force of Mom's troops are brought down on them! As they retreat into a fortress, Germa 66 springs in to action! However, Bege has bad news for his allied forces.

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats and Germa 66 are cornered in Bege's stronghold - with the full force of the Big Mom Pirates pinning them down, it's only a matter of time before their defenses crack. The only way out seems to be to make a break for it.
programme.sub-title: Cutting the Father-Son Relationship! Sanji and Judge!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The plan is executed to sneak the Straw Hats out of Big Mom's castle while hidden inside Bege! But the irascible Luffy can't resist getting in at least one punch against his foe! Meanwhile, the Tamate Box slips into the hands of some surprising agent!
programme.sub-title: Escape From the Tea Party! Luffy vs. Big Mom!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The full might of the Big Mom Pirates proves too much for the Straw Hats and Germa 66. With no other options, they decide to turn and fight, even though it means their total annihilation!
programme.sub-title: The Execution Begins! Luffy's Allied Forces Are Annihilated?!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Whole Cake Chateau starts crumbling while everyone is trying to escape for their lives! Luffy and the others get away and move on to the next stage of their escape, which involves some parting of ways.
programme.sub-title: The Castle Collapses! The Straw Hat’s Great Escape Begins!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats continue their mad dash to the Sunny! As Big Mom rages, her underlings decide to turn her Hunger Pang attacks against the Straw Hats! The Whole Cake Island scrambles to remake the cake to calm down Big Mom!
programme.sub-title: The Spear of Elbaph! Onslaught! The Flying Big Mom!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Kingbaum puts his life on the line ferrying the Straw Hats towards the Seducing Woods! But Big Mom's word trumps him in this terrifying forest, and soon enough she catches up! Meanwhile, Pudding puts her plan to rebuild the cake into action!
programme.sub-title: Pudding's Determination! Ablaze! The Seducing Woods!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zeus pursues the Straw Hats as Nami keeps him occupied. She has a shocking surprise in store for him, however, that might stop Big Mom in her tracks! Meanwhile, Brook and Chopper find the Shark Submerge in a strange situation.
programme.sub-title: A Lightning Counterattack! Nami and Zeus the Thundercloud!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Big Mom is relentless in her pursuit of the Straw Hats! Even being buried alive doesn't stop her! The plan to recreate the cake to stop her onslaught progresses, and Pudding's changeable heart confuses all those looking on!
programme.sub-title: A Coincidental Reunion! Sanji and the Lovestruck Evil Pudding!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Mama's onslaught continues as Pudding keeps battling the contradictory urges in her head - to kill or kiss Sanji! Meanwhile, Brook and Chopper are at Perospero's mercy - and are being reduced to sweetened versions of themselves!
programme.sub-title: Save the Sunny! Fighting Bravely! Chopper and Brook!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sandwiched between Big Mom and her advancing fleet, the only hope is the Sunny's Coup-de-Burst! But can the Straw Hats prepare it in time? Meanwhile, Pedro comes face to face with his past.
programme.sub-title: Before the Dawn! Pedro, the Captain of the Guardians!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The last chance the Straw Hats have is the Coup de Burst! Pedro has made the ultimate sacrifice to give them this one chance to escape, but Big Mom's naval forces are closing in and poised to knock them out!
programme.sub-title: I'll Be Back! Luffy, Deadly Departure

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami and the others who escaped the Whole Cake Island by Pedro's sacrifice mourn over his death. Jimbei, however, keeps his calm, which makes Brook lose his temper. Meanwhile, Luffy confronts the formidable Sweet General Katakuri in the Mirroworld.
programme.sub-title: The Man with a Bounty of Billion! The Strongest Sweet General, Katakuri!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Pudding and Sanji arrive at Cacao Island and begin to remake the only cake that will calm Big Mom! But their fake nuptials get in the way as they bicker like a married couple! Meanwhile, Luffy has lost the battle of his life.
programme.sub-title: A Hard Battle Starts! Luffy vs. Katakuri!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy keeps the forces out to destroy the Straw Hats at bay, however the crew needs to destroy all the mirrors - the final link that secure his safe return - on the ship in order to save themselves!
programme.sub-title: The Green Room! An Invincible Helmsman, Jimbei!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami and the others start breaking all the mirrors on the Sunny in order to keep their enemies out while she and Luffy discuss where to rendezvous – but little do they know the plan is overheard!
programme.sub-title: The Threat of the Mole! Luffy’s Silent Fight!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Both powerful combatants and strong users of Haki, Luffy and Katakuri are a dead match for each other. Every move is matched by their opponent! Elsewhere, the Big Mom Pirates square off against Germa!
programme.sub-title: The End of the Deadly Battle?! Katakuri's Awakening in Anger!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Katakuri retires to his sanctuary to enjoy the merienda - a chance for him to savor the sweetness of his crew of chefs and replenish his Haki!

programme.title: Puccini - La Boheme

programme.title: Berlioz

programme.title: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.

programme.title: Arriba y Abajo: La mariquita
programme.desc: Sin señales de distensión en la relación entre Lady Agnes y Maud, Hallam ve puestas a prueba en su hogar sus capacidades diplomáticas así como su trabajo.

programme.desc: Sir Hallam se ve en el centro de una crisis nacional cuando su amigo, el duque de Kent le pide ayuda. Mientras tanto, nubes de tormenta se acumulan en el 165 de Eaton Place.

programme.title: Arriba y Abajo: Un país lejano del que no sabemos nada
programme.desc: Cuando el 165 de Eaton Place reabre sus puertas, hacen aparición dos nuevas llegadas. Pero mientras la sincera tía Blanche de Sir Hallam perturba la vida de arriba, Beryl, la nueva mucama se esfuerza por adaptarse al servicio.
programme.sub-title: Un país lejano del que no sabemos nada

programme.title: Arriba y Abajo: El amor que paga el precio
programme.desc: Lady Agnes llama la atención del carismático millonario americano, Caspar Landry pero cuando ella y Sir Hallam miran por su futuro, un trágico giro de los eventos dejan sus prometidos sueños en peligro.
programme.sub-title: El amor que paga el precio

programme.title: Arriba y Abajo: Un perfecto espécimen de feminidad
programme.desc: Blanche está cara a cara con su último amante cuando se publica una escandalosa novela y cuando la pasión entre la pareja se reavive, empieza a considerar una vida alejada de Eaton Place.

programme.title: Arriba y Abajo: Todo lo que eres
programme.desc: El deseo de Harry para impresionar a Beryl les lleva a él y a Johnny al mundo del boxeo y, dado que sus peleas son cada vez mejores, los chicos están decididos a reinar victoriosos.

programme.title: Arriba y Abajo: El último vals
programme.desc: Cuando el 165 de Eaton Place se prepara para el Baile anual de la servidumbre, el sr. Pritchard dsfruta de un romance con su sirviente la srta. Whisset y empieza a preguntarse si hay algo má en la vida que el servicios.

programme.title: Arriba y Abajo: En algún lugar sobre el arco iris
programme.desc: En vísperas de la guerra, Beryl y Harry se enfrentan contra el tiempo para casarse. Mientras tanto, el sr. Pritchard toma una decisión que lleva al 165 al caos hasta que un antiguo rostro ofrece ayuda.
programme.sub-title: En algún lugar sobre el arco iris

programme.title: Tess de los d'Urbervilles: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Las dificultades fuerzan a Tess Durbeyfield a buscar apoyo de sus familiares los D'Urbervilles.

programme.title: Culpable: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Cuando Maggie profundiza en la desaparición de Callum Reid, un viaje a Alemania descubre la declaración de un testigo clave en una luz preocupante. Mientras tanto, Claire descubre implicaciones alarmantes.

programme.title: Culpable: Episodio 1
programme.desc: En 2008, un niño de cuatro años desaparece durante una barbacoa de barrio y el mundo de su familia se desmorona. Cinco años más tarde se encuentra su cuerpo enterrado a tan solo pocas yardas de su puerta.

programme.title: Culpable: Episodio 3
programme.desc: Bajo presión para cargar a su principal sospechoso, Maggy sigue sin estar convencida de haber encontrado al asesino. Mientras tanto, el regreso de Theresa lleva el matrimonio de Claire and Daniel a un punto álgido.

programme.title: Tess de los d'Urbervilles: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Tess vuelve a casa de los D'Ubervilles confundida y avergonzada después de seducida por el manìlador, Alec.

programme.title: Tess de los d'Urbervilles: Episodio 3
programme.desc: Tess acepta casarse con Ángel, para su felicidad. Cuando él confiesa un evento deshonroso del pasado, Tess siente que puede decirle cómo es su relación con Alec D'Urberville y sus consecuencias.

programme.title: Tess de los d'Urbervilles: Episodio 4
programme.desc: Ángel se fue a Brasil, dejando a Tess soportando un duro invierno en una granja donde ella es incansablemente perseguida por Alec.

programme.title: Orgullo y prejuicio: Episodio 1
programme.desc: La familia Bennet está emocionada con las noticias del nuevo huésped en Netherfield Hall. Conocen a Bingle, sus hermanas y al amigo Darcy en un baile, donde Bingle se siente atraido por Jane pero Dancy considera que toda la reunión está por debajo de él.

programme.title: Orgullo y prejuicio: Episodio 2
programme.desc: El primo separado del Sr. Bennet, el sr. Collins, escribe para anunciar su inmiente visita a Longbourn, la casa que heredará al morir el sr. Bennet.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Elixir
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force offers a "fountain of youth" to the vain and dictatorial widow (guest star Ruth Roman) of the late president of a small South American country in order to depose her.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Exchange
programme.desc: Cinnamon is captured and the enemy discovers the one thing that would unmask her identity and expose the Impossible Mission Force.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bargain
programme.desc: The former dictator of a Caribbean island is made to have hallucinatory visions in which he sees his ominous destiny as part of an ingenious plot designed by the Impossible Missions Force.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Mind of Stefan Miklos
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force is pitted against the ingenious logic of an enemy agent (guest Steve Ihnat) as the IMF attempts to lead the agent through a maze of complicated clues in order to reach a false conclusion.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Freeze
programme.desc: Before a statute of limitations expires on a 10-million dollar robbery, the Impossible Missions Force must spring the suspect from prison and dupe him into leading police to the hiding place of the money.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Test Case
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force must end the murderous career of a bacteriologist working for the enemy, who has succeeded in developing a mutant strain of a deadly bacteria which could be used as a practical battlefield weapon.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The System
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force led by Jim Phelps (Peter Graves) sets out to persuade the trusted henchman of a crime syndicate leader to testify against his boss.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Glass Cage
programme.desc: An electronically guarded prison confronts the Impossible Missions Force when it tries to free a political prisoner (Richard Garland) from an escape-proof glass cell.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Live Bait
programme.desc: The Impossible Missions Force invades the intricate world of spies to protect an American double agent and comes up against a human time bomb.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Doomsday
programme.desc: When an unscrupulous manufacturer risks World War III by offering a hydrogen bomb for sale, the Impossible Missions Force enters the bidding with a dangerous plan to keep the weapon out of enemy hands.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bunker, Pt. 1
programme.desc: The IMF races a paid killer who is stalking a nuclear scientist forced by the enemy to work on a device that could upset the world power balance in the first of a two-part episode.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Bunker, Pt. 2
programme.desc: While trying to free a nuclear scientist and his wife from enemy hands, the IMF is trapped when a would-be assassin takes over one of Rollin's disguises in Part 2.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Nitro
programme.desc: The IMF finds itself only a second away from eternity when they intercept a nitroglycerine expert who plans to blow up the government house of a small country, thus provoking war with its neighbor nation.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Vault
programme.desc: Guest star Nehemiah Persoff as a corrupt Latin American official plots to loot his own country of $40,000,000 with the connivance of the IMF.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Nicole
programme.desc: Guest star Joan Collins, as a seductive double agent, endangers a vital IMF project when Jim Phelps falls in love with her.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: Illusion
programme.desc: Cinnamon and Rollin become cabaret performers in a plot to get a deranged man (guest Fritz Weaver) to fall in love with Cinnamon, then kill her.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible: The Interrogator
programme.desc: In a bold experiment with a man's mind, the IMF blanks out an enemy agent's memory (guest star Henry Silva), then sets out to make him think he is someone else.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Duell im Kolosseum (1)
programme.desc: It’s the rematch we’ve all been waiting for! Yugi and Kaiba square off for the first time since Duelist Kingdom in front of thousands of ravenous fans for the right to challenge Marik! It’s time to duel!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Duell im Kolosseum (2)
programme.desc: Kaiba has all the monsters necessary to summon Obelisk the Tormentor to finish Yugi off! Though overwhelmed and outmatched, nothing is going to stop Yugi from trying to summon his Egyptian God first!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Duell im Kolosseum (3)
programme.desc: When Yugi’s Slifer the Sky Dragon clashes against Kaiba’s Obelisk the Tormentor, what will happen when two Egyptian Gods fight each other? It’s time to find out which Egyptian God is truly stronger!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Duell im Kolosseum (4)
programme.desc: The clash of the two Egyptian God Monsters releases mystical energies that show Yugi and Kaiba visions of the ancient Egyptian past! What new answers do these images unlock, and what prophecies do they make for the future?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Duell im Kolosseum (5)
programme.desc: Kaiba summons three powerful Blue-Eyes White Dragons, but Yugi has no monsters remaining in his deck! Is losing only a matter of time, or will a long-dormant card from a fallen friend help turn the tide of battle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Duell im Kolosseum (6)
programme.desc: Kaiba not only controls Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, but his Final Attack Orders card leaves Yugi with only three cards in his deck! If Yugi loses, he’ll have to give up his chance to save the world from Marik’s evil!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Joey gegen Kaiba (1)
programme.desc: Tired of Kaiba’s insults, Joey challenges Kaiba for third place in the Battle City Tournament! Has Joey mastered enough strategies to take down the top dog, or is Kaiba going to wallop Joey like a pathetic puppy?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Joey gegen Kaiba (2)
programme.desc: Kaiba attacks with his mighty Blue-Eyes White Dragon, but Joey has no monsters to defend with! Joey’s luck has run out, so it’s time for him to rely on skill!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Joey gegen Kaiba (3)
programme.desc: Joey and Kaiba’s battle reaches its roaring climax! Will Joey take down his biggest headache and actually teach Kaiba a thing or two about being a true duelist?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi gegen Marik (1)
programme.desc: It’s the critical Battle City showdown with the fate of the world at stake: Yami Yugi vs. Marik! If Yami Yugi loses, Yugi is taking a permanent vacation into the Shadow Realm!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi gegen Marik (2)
programme.desc: Marik proves his The Winged Dragon of Ra is the strongest Egyptian God Card by destroying Slifer the Sky Dragon! None of Yugi’s cards can withstand its assault, but a gift from Kaiba may turn the duel around…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi gegen Marik (3)
programme.desc: Yugi can’t strike Marik’s life points, and with every turn that passes, Marik is one step closer to taking down Yugi with a final strike from The Winged Dragon of Ra...

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi gegen Marik (4)
programme.desc: With Yugi at the end of his ropes and the maniacal Marik waging all-out war, can Marik’s oldest friend reach Marik in time to help him come to his senses before his insanity overwhelms him?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Yugi gegen Marik (5)
programme.desc: Will the combined force of all of Yugi’s monsters be enough to defeat an Egyptian God that terminated two other powerful Egyptian Gods? The fate of the world hangs in the balance with the finale of the Battle City Tournament!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Das Ende von Battle City
programme.desc: KaibaCorp Island is set to explode in mere minutes, but the blimp’s engines are offline! Can Yugi and friends escape from the island in time, or will they sink to the bottom of the sea?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Der Film
programme.desc: Der heldenhafte Yugi kämpft gegen seinen Erzrivalen Kaiba in einem Abenteuer, das noch gefährlicher wird, als die imaginären Monster in ihren Spielkarten grausam real werden ... und als ein altes Übel in den Kampf eingreift.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Kampf um die Seele - Teil 1
programme.desc: Yugis drei ägyptischen Götterkarten wurden gestohlen. Gurimo, der Dieb der Karten zwingt daraufhin Yugi zu einem Duell um seine Seele heraus. Zunächst behält Yugi die Oberhand.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Kampf um die Seele - Teil 2
programme.desc: Obwohl Yugi als Gewinner aus dem Duell gegen Gurimo heraus ging, sind die Götterkarten nicht in seinem Deck. Die Motorradgang, um Valon, Alister und Rafael konnten die drei Karten stehlen und sind unbemerkt damit davon gekommen.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Legende der Drachen
programme.desc: Nicht nur, dass die Welt kurz vor dessen Untergang steht, hinzu kommt das plötzliche Auftauchen einer riesigen Bestie. Um sich zu stärken, ernährt sich dieses von Menschen und Monstern.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Der Schöpfer kehrt zurück
programme.desc: Yugi wird von Kaiba zu einem persönlichen Gespräch eingeladen. Yugi nimmt das Angebot an, aber nur unter der Bedingung, dass seine Freunde teilnehmen dürfen. Indem Pegasus eifrig Aktien der Kaiba Cooporation kauft, zwingt er Kaiba zu einem Duell.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Déjà vu - Teil 1
programme.desc: Kaiba nimmt die Herausforderung von Pegasus an. Jedoch verbirgt Pegasus hinter seiner Strategie ein dunkles Geheimnis. Wird Kaiba rechtzeitig hinter dieses Geheimnis kommen, bevor er im Duell gegen Pegasus seine Seele verliert?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Déjà vu - Teil 2
programme.desc: Pegasus, der in Wirklichkeit Alister ist, kämpft im Duell gegen Kaiba mit seinen Feuerwesen. Das schwarze Magiermädchen eilt dem unterlegenen Kaiba zur Hilfe. Mit ihrer Unterstützung erscheint der mächtige Drache Critius in Kaibas Deck.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Freund oder Feind?
programme.desc: Auf dem Weg zu Industrial Illusion, dem Sitz von Pegasus, werden Joey, Tea, Tristan und Yugi von einer Motorradgang in einen Hinterhalt gelockt. Doch ein Freund kann sie aus dieser misslichen Lage in letzter Sekunde befreien.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Geliebter Gegner - Teil 1
programme.desc: Wie sich im Gebäude von Industrial Illusion herausstellte, unterliegt Mai einer Gehirnwäsche und ist in Folge dessen zu einem Feind von Yugi und seinen Freunden geworden. Mai fordert die vier Freunde zu verschieden Duellen heraus.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Geliebter Gegner - Teil 2
programme.desc: Während dem Duell gegen Joey, wird Mais Geschichte offenbart. Mai erhielt von Datz die absolute Macht, um ein Duell zu gewinnen. Als Preis musste sie ihre gute Seele ablegen. Joey erhält in einer anderer Dimension eine mächtige Drachenkarte.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Geliebter Gegner - Teil 3
programme.desc: Kurz bevor Yugi ein Unentschieden im Duell gegen Mai erreichen kann, zerstört Valon das Siegel des Orichalcos und verschwindet daraufhin mit Mai und Rafael. Kaiba, Joey und Yugi gelangen in ein geheimes Zimmer.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die falsche Geisel
programme.desc: Professor Hawkins will Yugi über seine neuesten Entdeckungen in Kenntnis setzen. Doch er wird vorher von Rafael entführt. Unbemerkt macht sich Yugi auf den Weg den Professor zu retten. Dabei gerät Yugi selbst in eine gefährliche Lage.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Das Schicksal des Pharao - Teil 1
programme.desc: Yami-Yugi wird von Rafael zu einem Duell herausgefordert. Falls Rafael gewinnt, will er die Welt retten indem er die Seele des Pharaos nutzt. Aufgrund Rafaels Wächterkarten stellt das Duell für Yugi eine vollkommen neue Herausforderung dar.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Das Schicksal des Pharao - Teil 2
programme.desc: Im Duell gegen Yami-Yugi spielt Rafael die Karte Austausch. Daraufhin kann er seinen Kontrahenten das Siegel von Orichalcos andrehen. Rafael bringt Yami-Yugi dazu, dass er die Karte ausspielt.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Das Schicksal des Pharao - Teil 3
programme.desc: Die dritte Runde im Duell von Yami-Yugi und Rafael steht an. Infolge des Spielens des Siegels von Orichalcos, verändert Yami-Yugi sein Wesen. Aufgrund des gierigen Bestrebens das Duell zu gewinnen opfert er ein Monster nach dem Anderen.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Im Bannkreis des Steins
programme.desc: Anlässlich der Niederlage im Duell gegen Rafael geht die Seele des Pharaos über in den Besitz von Dartz. Joey, seine Freunde und der Professor begeben sich auf die Suche nach Dartz.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Zug um Zug - Teil 1
programme.desc: Joey, Tea, Tristan und Yami-Yugi suchen nach Dartz. Als sie in einen Zug eingestiegen sind, sind die restlichen Fahrgäste verschwunden. Daraufhin werden die Freunde getrennt und Joey und Yami-Yugi müssen sich mit Rex Raptor und Weevil duellieren.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Gegen das eigene Ich
programme.desc: Die Eisenbahn, in welcher sich Tea und Yami-Yugi befinden, entgleist. Als sie wieder aufwachen, befinden sie sich im Zelt von Chris und Eisenherz. Die Gruppe begibt sich zum heiligen Tal, wo man die Seelen aus der anderen Welt begegnen kann.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!: Die Vergangenheit lebt
programme.desc: Im Duell gegen einen Feind aus längst vergangenen Tagen, versetzen Visionen den Pharao in eine Zeit zurück, in welcher die letzte Schlacht um Atlantis gefochten wurde. Unterstützung erhält der Pharao durch seine Freunde Chris und Eisenherz.
